ideas.title: Investigation into Trump administration's child care funding freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the decision-making process behind the Trump administration's freeze on child care grants, potential biases, and impact on low-income families.
questions: What was the decision-making process behind the freeze?
What are the potential biases behind the freeze?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential wrongdoing or abuse of power within the Trump administration.
